narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to share and critique a controversial dating viewpoint regarding the 'AA' (splitting the bill) culture. By using an energetic and humorous storytelling style combined with rapid social-media editing, the creator engages the audience in a discussion about dating standards and social labels like 'Rich Second Generation' versus 'Average Man.'
